title.en: Can pocket i find its three local libraries without reading them into the network?
title.ru: Сможет ли pocket i найти три локальные библиотеки, не передавая их в сеть?

human_checkpoint: The owner must inspect the MacBook inventory before any parser or index is built.
honest_boundary: Finding candidate files does not prove that every conversation is present or that the file format can already be parsed. ChatGPT cloud-backed history may be only partially cached locally.
